# Latex in Rmd files

I will put a math equation here, $x = (1+y)^2$. (inline math mode)

$$mean = \bar{x} = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^n x_i$$

$$\sqrt{x+1}$$

```{r}
prob1 = tibble(
  x = 0:4,
  p = c(0.15, 0.25, 0.05, 0.35, NA)
)

## long format
prob1
```
```{r}
prob1[5,2] <- 0.2

prob1
```
- What is the mean of the random variable with the previous distribution? What are the variance and standard deviation of the random variable from problem 1?


```{r}
prob1 %>% mutate(xp = x*p, "(x-mu)2p" = (x-sum(xp))^2*p) %>% 
  summarize(mu = sum(xp), sigma2 = sum(`(x-mu)2p`), sigma = sqrt(sigma2))
```

- Draw a graph of the discrete distribution.

```{r}
ggplot(prob1, aes(x = x, y = p)) +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = x, yend = 0), color = "blue", size = 3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) 
```
